Input roles: Image1 is the ACTUAL exported donor's YARD/BACK face and is authoritative for five boards, two battens, diagonal brace, proportions and open gaps. Image2 is the ACTUAL opposite FRONT face of the SAME donor and confirms the five boards and gaps. Image3 is the author-accepted URMAN house gameplay frame and supplies ONLY the quiet weathered painterly3D material family and winter color response, not its buildings, people, pine forest, sky, snow or composition.
Primary request: Show ONE complete isolated wooden gate LEAF as Image1, in its yard-face orientation, a very slight three-quarter angle so the true thin board/brace thickness is readable while all five front uprights, both bearing battens and the single diagonal brace remain clear. Match the exact modest shape/proportions of the donor rather than designing another gate. Nominal leaf1.36mwide×1.05mhigh, five235mm-wide30mm-thick upright planks separated by four roughly46mm air gaps; tops only mildly uneven as shown. Two1.30m horizontal bearing battens and one structurally seated diagonal wooden brace on the yard face, as in Image1. Keep all timber connected, no ground stand, no posts, arch, fence bay or separate gate frame. The main five boards remain one recognizable complete leaf.
Materials: weathered quiet medium-to-dark brown rural timber, softened grey-brown grain, sparse believable age marks and modest end-grain at exposed cut edges. The restrained brown/material family of the wooden house in Image3. Grain must follow the length of each member: vertical on the five boards, horizontal along both battens, diagonal along the brace. The brace and rails read as their own solid brown wooden members with slightly distinct values, no white/ivory paint. Carefully worn edges and subtle matte roughness, controlled broad painterly surface variation suitable for actual3D game lighting, readable but not noisy. No glossy varnish, oversaturated orange wood, flat plastic, photographic cracks, extreme rot or theatrical distress.
Scene/framing: one complete leaf centered on a plain neutral mid warmgrey background, all corners/tops/edges visible with clean margin, soft diffuse neutral studio light and very mild contact shadow only. Landscape composition, no labels or split views. The four gaps are REAL OPEN AIR matching the background; do not fill them with dark painted backing or extra boards. No snow baked into the base timber; runtime owns weather/snow separately.
Constraints: do not add any hardware. Hinge pin, latch, handles, nails, metal straps, surroundingposts and all physics are separate existing runtime owners and intentionally absent from these source inputs. No pedestal, mound, grounddisc, supportingfoot, landscape, house, human, forest, text, watermark, collage. Preserve the five-board/two-batten/one-brace construction and quiet brown wood separation. Produce exactlyONE coherent entire gate-leaf material reference.
